diagram_math_checks.result: R is commutative as in the unchanged Statement. All nine X tensor_R T objects (X=A,B,C; T=K,F,N) are R-modules, so these tensor maps are well typed; no noncommutative left/right convention is added.

For each T=K,F,N, i tensor 1_T maps A tensor T to B tensor T and p tensor 1_T maps B tensor T to C tensor T. Their composite vanishes since p i=0 (Given/L5 and tensor functoriality). Step 2.2 gives the short exact F row and right-exact K row; steps 6.1–7.1 establish short exactness of the N row. There is deliberately no initial zero on the K row.

Step 1.1 supplies j:K→F and epsilon:F→N with epsilon j=0. The vertical arrows are 1_X tensor j and 1_X tensor epsilon for X=A,B,C, not unsupported maps X→X tensor N. The four interior squares commute: (f tensor 1_F)(1_X tensor j)=(1_Y tensor j)(f tensor 1_K), and (f tensor 1_N)(1_X tensor epsilon)=(1_Y tensor epsilon)(f tensor 1_F), for f=i:X=A,Y=B and f=p:X=B,Y=C; both sides send x tensor t to f(x) tensor j(t) or f(x) tensor epsilon(t). The squares with zero modules also commute.

Step 2.1 and L2 give right-exact columns X tensor K→X tensor F→X tensor N→0; epsilon j=0 makes each column composite zero. Flatness of C alone marks 1_C tensor j injective. Flatness of the chosen free F (L3; supplier cor-free-modules-are-projective-and-flat Statement 3) makes the F row short exact. No flatness of A, B, K or arbitrary N is used or claimed.
The original proof steps 1.1–7.1 are byte-for-byte unchanged; step 6.1 proves the N-row initial injection without relying on the new figure.
